description: ebcpy is RWTH Aachen University's Python utility package for building and energy-system model studies. It provides SimulationAPI interfaces, an optimisation wrapper, time-series loading and cleaning, pre- and post-processing, and Modelica-related utilities. A researcher supplies a separate building or HVAC model and its input series; ebcpy helps run, calibrate and compare outputs, not publishing a calibrated building model itself. Spatial coverage and time step therefore follow the linked model and the user-supplied data. The package is free under BSD-3-Clause terms, installs with pip, and has a tutorial and examples. Optional optimisation features need additional packages, and a simulation still needs the external model and suitable parameter data. The README says the interfaces were extracted from AixCaliBuHA, but the package is a separate reusable tool. It serves building digital-twin calibration, heat-pump design studies and energy-model workflows. The catalogue's model-modelica-buildings-library supplies building-system models that are conceptually relevant, but this review did not test an ebcpy connection to that library. No simulation or optimisation was run.
